label: Trial-count fit (research)
endpoint: maximum grade >= 3 acute mucositis (or confluent), arm-level counts, 22 randomized trial families (51 arms, 6042 evaluable patients)
model: logit p = eta_trial + kappa * (E - E_ref) + gamma * chemo + arm effect; E = D + Q/ab - r * max(0, T_elapsed - Tk), Q with incomplete repair
status: research scenario; Fowler 2003 is the app default. Validation: better held-out log score across 22 trial families (+0.28 per family); HYPNO depends on its chemotherapy assumption; ELAN-RT (frail, split course) favored the Fowler-parameter benchmark.
